criteria.description: Primary shell and mega disclosure reach every documented state: desktop hover/click open-close with pin semantics, keyboard Enter/Space, Escape with focus return from summary or focused destination, outside/destination/CTA/mobile/breakpoint close, mobile activation-only panel, same-breakpoint resize stability

Exactly one brand, four top entries (3 plain + 1 disclosure), two category groups with five title-only links each (10), two whole-card collection anchors without nested interactive descendants, two actions, one named toggle, one chevron — single landmark/tree, no invented chrome

Desktop full-width bar with logo-left/menu/actions-end and full-bleed under-bar mega (categories narrower than collections); mobile closed row logo+toggle only; open mobile stacks links then full-width actions; 320/340 narrow widths and 767/768/769 seams; 44px targets; no html/root overflow
axe WCAG 2.1 AA clean on the preview root; light/dark surfaces resolve through RenDS tokens; reduced-motion zeros block-local transitions; JS-disabled mobile remains usable
Independent Codex reviewed fresh desktop and mobile captures against the reference brief
